answer: Each identity attracts an unaffiliated underwriter who stakes a bond vouching for its independence, logged as a public beacon the jury reopens. That bond is slashed when a shared-control pulse proves the backed identity a clone. Honest underwriters are a scarce meadow of outside parties with reputations to lose, so a farm of N clones must source N separate underwriters, none knowingly co-signing a sybil; the marginal fake costs a fresh outside relationship no coalition can manufacture per alias. Pooling collapses it: one underwriter backing many aliases is flagged as a cluster and burned.
